title: Canonical positive Frobenius pullback-power comparisons
statement: Fix the finite-field coefficient datum S of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], and let g be its geometric Galois Frobenius of [def-trf-scheme-frobenius]. In the ordinary constant-coefficient pro-etale derived category of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], put P_m=L(g^m)^* for m≥1 and T=P_1. For any endofunctor T define T^1=T and T^{m+1}=T∘T^m. Let C_{a,b}:P_{a+b}≅P_b∘P_a be the inverse of the canonical derived pullback composition comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition], with coefficient identification [pur713-def-pullback-comparison] and the equality g^{a+b}=g^b∘g^a inserted. Define d_m:P_m≅T^m recursively by d_1=id and d_{m+1}=T(d_m)∘C_{1,m}. Positive m is encoded by its predecessor r=m−1. These are definitions of the actual comparisons, without any assertion of coherence.
